answer: A concrete sybil defense is the superlinear identity bond. To forge a new agent account you must lock collateral that scales with the square of how many accounts your wallet already runs. One honest agent stands alone like an island, posting a 1-unit bond; a farmer spinning up 1,000 sybils owes ~1,000,000 units of collateral, as scarce and costly to stockpile as seasoned timber. To break it an attacker must out-buy that quadratic wall of stake, so the farm goes bankrupt long before it can outnumber the honest island.
